description: Scan a published package (npm, PyPI, crates, Docker, or Hugging Face) with AgentAvow. Returns one of three answers with its reason (Safe to connect, Review before you connect, or Do not connect), a 0-100 trust score, an adoption score from real usage (downloads per week), findings with remediation, and a signed attestation. Also reports published advisories that affect the scanned version, the maintainer's deprecation notice, repo-vs-artifact drift (files shipped that aren't in the source), and AgentAvow's behavioral sandbox results when available. Scans the latest version unless `version` (or a pin in the name) names one. Read-only; calls agentavow.com.

force.description: Re-scan now instead of returning the cached verdict (results cache ~1h). Use after a new version ships.

registry.description: Package registry: npm, pypi, crates, docker, or hf.

version.description: Exact version to scan, e.g. '5.3.0'. Optional: the latest version by default. A pin in the name ('chalk@5.3.0', 'requests==2.32.5') works too.

name: scan_package

adoption.description: The adoption score: real usage (downloads per week, stars or installs). Never changes the decision.

advisories_affecting_version.description: Published advisories that affect this version.

certified_mark.description: Certified and safe: show the Certified mark.

coverage_gaps.description: Machine form of not_checked: gap kinds (e.g. tool_list_paged, oversized_files) with a flag or count. Empty when nothing was skipped.

decision.description: The answer to lead with: safe = Safe to connect, review = Review before you connect, do_not_connect = Do not connect.

decision_final.description: False while the behavioral sandbox is still running; the decision can still change.

decision_reason.description: One sentence naming what decided it.

deprecated.description: The maintainer's deprecation notice, or null.

incident.description: Known past compromise (context only, never scored).

install.description: Install command, only when nothing blocks it.

not_checked.description: Plain-English notes for what the scan could not read or check (empty when it read everything). Say these alongside the answer.

rescan_pending.description: A fresh scan was started; this is the previous result.

sandbox.description: What the behavioral sandbox observed; null if it does not apply.

signed.description: True when a signed (Ed25519/JWS) attestation backs this.

subscores.description: Per-category 0-100 scores behind the trust score.

target_type.description: github, npm, pypi, crates, docker, hf, or mcp.

tier.description: Trust tier for the score (detail, not the headline).

top_findings.description: Up to five most important findings.

trust_score.description: Trust score, 0-100. Evidence under the decision.

verdict.description: Binary form of the decision, kept for older clients.

verdict_reason.description: Machine reason for the binary verdict, e.g. clean, clean_partial (clean, but not everything was read), blocking_findings, thin_coverage.

title: Scan a package
